imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures of every active site at zoom 19; visible building, adjacent parking and apron/circulation estimated against map scale.

roads.assessment: Packaged local road and service centerlines were reviewed alongside imagery. Spawns are modeled projections to selected road centerlines and do not establish driveway ownership, gate access or apparatus entrances.

limits: Rectangle centers, dimensions, rotations and spawn coordinates are imagery- and road-map-based estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No official parcel plans, building footprints or apparatus entrance locations were used.
Satellite imagery dates are not supplied by the tile response.
Canonical source coordinates, base IDs and active statuses are preserved.
